% \textsurd (√) in an 11pt document, where tex4ht magnifies the 10pt Latin
% Modern fonts and names their classes with the magnification, such as
% ts1-lmbx10-x-x-109. The sign takes the weight and shape of bold, italic,
% and bold italic text at 11pt, and of small bold text, which is set in the
% same font at 10pt.
\documentclass[11pt]{article}
\usepackage[T1]{fontenc}
\usepackage{lmodern}
\usepackage{textcomp}
\begin{document}
Plain \textsurd{} sign.
\textit{Italic \textsurd{} sign.}
\textbf{Bold \textsurd{} sign.}
\textbf{\textit{Bolditalic \textsurd{} sign.}}
{\small\bfseries Smallbold \textsurd{} sign.}
\end{document}
